items.title: Subquadratic sum-of-squares composition formulas over complex and positive-characteristic fields
items.author: Pavel Hrubeš
items.source_version: CCC 2024, LIPIcs volume 300 article 12, 2024-07-15, official PDF pp.12:1-12:11; editable author-text transcription
items.difficulty_reason: The author builds a new parity representation from multilinear interpolation, combines it with classical anticommuting matrices by tensor products, and optimizes the resulting sum-of-squares construction using entropy. The positive-characteristic case requires a distinct binomial-matrix interpolation argument, whose full author proof is included. These are nonroutine algebraic constructions.
